prompts.prefix.title: Prefix
prompts.prefix.description: Added at the very start of every agent's system prompt; empty by default. Not added to scope review, compaction instructions or handoff summaries. No placeholders allowed
prompts.secretary.description: System prompt for the conversation entry point. After a change, it restarts with the new prompt once the current message is handled, taking effect from the next turn
prompts.secretaryCompaction.description: Used to write the summary when the long-running main conversation is compacted (appended after pi's summary prompt)
prompts.memoryCurator.title: Memory curator
prompts.memoryCurator.description: System prompt for the memory curator (the resident agent that consolidates at 03:00 every night and that you can talk to on the Memory page). Takes effect from its next turn
prompts.plainTask.title: Plain task agent
prompts.plainTask.description: Plain tasks not tied to a project (or tied to several): does the work in the background and reports the result in a sentence or two; scheduled ones run again and again on their schedule. Takes effect the next time it's woken
prompts.taskMaintainer.title: Long-running task maintainer
prompts.taskMaintainer.description: A task's own maintainer (long-running tasks outside projects): used for both drafting the plan and executing it; multi-project task maintainers start with it too
prompts.workflowMaintainer.title: Workflow maintainer
prompts.workflowMaintainer.description: Workflows outside projects: lays the work out as steps and follows them after you authorize once; scheduled ones are authorized once and follow the steps on every run
prompts.multiProjectMaintainer.title: Multi-project task maintainer
prompts.multiProjectMaintainer.descripti: Tasks spanning several projects: starts with the long-running task maintainer's prompt, followed by instructions for dispatching work orders and waiting for receipts
prompts.projectMaintainer.title: Project maintainer
prompts.projectMaintainer.description: A project's own maintainer: project setup Q&A, conversation, work orders (drafting plans, executing). Restarts with the new prompt when project facts (name, state, toolkit) change
prompts.projectWorkflow.title: Project maintainer · Workflow work order
prompts.projectWorkflow.description: Appended after the project maintainer's prompt when the current work order is a workflow
prompts.projectPlain.title: Project maintainer · Plain task work order
prompts.projectPlain.description: Appended after the project maintainer's prompt when the current work order is one of the project's plain internal tasks
prompts.projectStandard.title: Project maintainer · Project standards
prompts.projectStandard.description: The project standards in the fixed context at the start of each of the project maintainer's sessions (a short first-stage description)
prompts.jobMaintainer.title: Agent for migrated scheduled tasks
prompts.jobMaintainer.description: Scheduled jobs registered before ticket 76 and not in a project (now migrated to scheduled plain tasks); it does every run
prompts.subAgent.title: Sub-agent
prompts.subAgent.description: Sub-agents sent out after a maintainer proposes parallel work and you agree
prompts.reviewer.title: Reviewer
prompts.reviewer.description: The reviewer sub-agent that independently judges whether deliverables meet the acceptance criteria during stage acceptance
prompts.scopeReview.title: Scope review
prompts.scopeReview.description: Finds the model calls with scope changes or overreach in a stretch of a maintainer's work log (outputs JSON only; uses a cheap model)
prompts.handoffSummary.title: Handoff summary when switching models
prompts.triggeredRuns.title: Each run of a scheduled task
prompts.triggeredRuns.description: How scheduled plain tasks and workflows handle each run (runs continue the same session; how to report when something can't be done). Only present when the task is scheduled
prompts.attachments.title: Attachments
prompts.attachments.description: How to read attachments you send in full (read_attachment, only within this conversation) and how to send files from the working directory to you as attachments (send_attachment, only when “Send attachments” is on in the toolkit). Included by task, project and scheduled job maintainers (ticket 143)
prompts.tempFiles.title: Temporary files
prompts.tempFiles.description: Where bash temp files go (ticket 177): the temp folder $TMPDIR inside the working directory (.ergo-tmp, which the guard treats as inside the project), not /tmp (the system temp folder, outside the project). Included by maintainers and sub-agents
prompts.tellSecretary.title: Messaging the Secretary
prompts.tellSecretary.description: When to use tell_secretary to message the Secretary, who passes it on to you (ticket 102). Included by maintainers, sub-agents and reviewers; none of them have the tool when “Message the Secretary” is off in the toolkit
prompts.planWriting.title: How to write a plan
prompts.planWriting.description: What every maintainer drafting a plan needs to know: stages, authorizations, watch categories, limits you've stated
prompts.execution.title: Moving execution forward
prompts.execution.description: How to move forward during execution: declaring stages done, reporting progress, parallel work, plan changes; thresholds go at the end
prompts.thresholds.title: Runtime thresholds
prompts.thresholds.description: The part where the runtime watches for drift; numbers follow the tasks.thresholds config
prompts.workflowRules.title: How workflows work
prompts.workflowRules.description: The fixed-plan way of working, along with the rules for writing plan parameters and conditions
prompts.secretaryCompaction.title: Compaction instructions for {assistant}
prompts.handoffSummary.description: When the model is changed in Settings, the old model writes a handoff summary with this before {assistant}, a project maintainer's conversation segment, or the agent of a migrated scheduled job starts a new session (appended after pi's summary prompt)
prompts.flag.secretary: True when writing the handoff summary for {assistant}'s long-running main conversation
prompts.value.pullBacks: How many pull-backs (returned by rules) before stopping on the next violation (config tasks.thresholds.pullBacks)
prompts.value.stallMinutes: How many minutes without progress counts as stalled (stallMinutes)
prompts.value.nudges: How many nudges during one stall (nudges)
prompts.value.acceptanceReturns: How many stage-acceptance returns before stopping if it still fails (acceptanceReturns)
prompts.value.acceptanceReturnsPlusOne: The previous item plus one: the attempt at which it stops if it still fails
prompts.value.budgetAskTimes: At how many times over budget this branch stops (budgetAskTimes): written as “用量超过预算” (1×) or “用量超过预算的 2 倍”; only actually stops when budget control is on
prompts.value.budgetExplainTimes: At how many times over budget the maintainer has to explain progress (budgetExplainTimes), same wording as above; only actually asked when budget control is on
prompts.value.rejections: How many total rejections from you (approvals, plan changes) pause the whole task (rejections)
prompts.flag.budgetControl: True when config tasks.thresholds.budgetControl is on (ticket 93: off by default, so going over budget neither asks for an explanation nor stops)
prompts.flag.conversationApprovals: True when config guard.conversationApprovals is on (off by default)
prompts.flag.triggered: True when the task is scheduled (ticket 76: runs again and again on its schedule) or event-triggered (ticket 77: runs once for each awaited event)
prompts.value.jobFailures: How many failures in a row before a scheduled task pauses itself (config scheduledJobs.jobFailures)
prompts.value.assistantName: The name you gave it (set in Settings)
prompts.value.projectState: The project's current state (preparing, building, in use…)
prompts.value.projectType: Project type confirmed in the charter (development, other)
prompts.value.toolkitBash: “工具包带 bash” or “工具包不带 bash” (toolkit with / without bash)
prompts.value.network: “能” if the toolkit has network on, otherwise “不能”
prompts.flag.charterConfirmed: True once the charter is confirmed (the project type is set)
prompts.flag.externalWorkDir: True when the working directory is bound to an external path
prompts.value.legacyJobFailures: How many failures in a row before a scheduled job pauses itself (config scheduledJobs.jobFailures)
prompts.value.readOnlyTools: Read-only tools the reviewer can use (read, ls, grep, find)
prompts.flag.canRunCommands: True when the task's toolkit has bash on: the reviewer can also run commands in the working directory (ticket 112 fix)
prompts.common.systemNoticeTag: Marker at the start of messages the runtime sends to agents
prompts.common.boardChangeTag: Marker at the start of the runtime's board-change message
prompts.common.taskDoneTag: Marker at the start of the runtime's notice to the Secretary when a task is done (including each run of scheduled and event-triggered tasks)
prompts.common.autoAnnounceTag: Marker right after the task-done marker when a task with “Speak when done” finishes (this turn can send voice directly)
prompts.common.relayTag: Marker at the start of what's handed to an agent when the Secretary relays your words into an existing conversation (ticket 103)
prompts.common.letterTag: Marker at the start of the notice the runtime hands to the Secretary when a maintainer (or sub-agent, reviewer) messages it with tell_secretary
prompts.common.correctionTag: Marker at the start of the tool result when the plan check pulls a workflow maintainer back
prompts.common.launchWorkflow: Typing this means you're explicitly starting a workflow
prompts.common.launchLongRunning: Typing this means you're explicitly starting a long-running task
prompts.common.historyDir: Name of the folder in project records that keeps old versions
prompts.common.workflowStepTools: Tools that workflow steps can use (separated by “、”)
prompts.problem.empty: Can't be empty (restore the default if you want the default)
prompts.problem.missedAtRender: Line {line}: {what} had no value while assembling “{prompt}” (a case the check missed), so the default is used for now. Edit it or restore the default
prompts.noDataDir: No data directory, so system prompts can't be changed
prompts.problem.ownMissed: Line {line}: {what} had no value during assembly (a case the check missed), so the shared template is used for now. Edit it or go back to the shared template
prompts.noDataDirOwn: No data directory, so the agent's own prompt can't be changed
